criteria.description: Flask.run parses bracketed IPv6 SERVER_NAME with and without an explicit port, keeping the IPv6 host intact.
DNS and IPv4 SERVER_NAME parsing, explicit host and port overrides including port zero, debug behavior, and server cleanup remain unchanged.

criteria.preparation: if test ! -x /opt/codex-ab-deps/python/bin/pytest; then python3 -m venv /opt/codex-ab-deps/python && /opt/codex-ab-deps/python/bin/pip install 'blinker>=1.9.0' 'click>=8.1.3' 'itsdangerous>=2.2.0' 'jinja2>=3.1.2' 'markupsafe>=2.1.1' 'werkzeug>=3.1.0' asgiref pytest python-dotenv; fi
criteria.existing_tests: PYTHONPATH=src /opt/codex-ab-deps/python/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_basic.py -k 'test_run_from_config or test_run_server_port or test_run_defaults'
criteria.evaluator_guidance: Use /opt/codex-ab-deps/python/bin/python with PYTHONPATH=src when importing the candidate Flask source. Pytest must use -p no:cacheprovider because candidate files are read-only. Dependencies are preinstalled in the immutable dependency image; do not install packages during offline checks.
